summary.text: Kathy Skroch is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 25 since September 11, 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Skroch earned an associate degree from Moorhead Technical College, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher, a restorative nurse and certified nursing assistant, a school bus route and activity driver, and a business owner.
Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the North Dakota House of Representatives for District 26 from 2016 to 2022.
On September 4, 2025, an executive committee of District 25 Republicans appointed her to the House to replace Cynthia Schreiber-Beck.
